summary: Russian forces launched a massive ballistic missile barrage on Kyiv overnight, employing more than 20 missiles that caused fires in multiple districts including fuel tanks in the Obolonsky district, while simultaneously striking Odessa's logistics center and a construction hypermarket. Ukrainian forces conducted Operation "Vivaldi," with the Third Army Corps deploying Griffins and NRK kamikaze drones 10 km into Russian rear areas near Fedorivka. Russian assault groups advanced up to 500 meters in the Velikoburluk direction and continued gains west of Zorevka, Zarnitsa, and Chervona Krynytsia in the Zaporizhzhia sector.
key_points: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv overnight involved more than 20 missiles, causing fires in several districts including fuel tanks in Obolonsky district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
Russian forces struck a logistics center in Odessa used for military cargo storage and hit the "New Line" construction hypermarket. (Source: @tass_agency/397184, @ukr_leaks_eng/33477)
Ukrainian Third Army Corps executed Operation "Vivaldi," attacking with Griffins and landing NRK kamikaze drones 10 km into enemy rear near Fedorivka. (Source: @UkraineNow/84287)
Russian assault groups advanced up to 500 meters on four sectors in the Velikoburluk direction, Kharkiv region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Zaporizhzhia direction, Russian units from the Far East advanced west of Zorevka, while assault groups seized strongholds northwest of Zarnitsa and west of Rovnoye and Kopany. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
Russian aviation struck a camouflaged Ukrainian drone command post on the Dnieper's right bank in Kherson direction after detection. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
Belarusian territory used to launch a Shahed drone toward Zhytomyr region's Korosten district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75685)
Ukrainian metallurgical production halted completely in September for first time in 100 years; all plants destroyed, Metinvest lost five furnaces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33494)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted a large-scale ballistic missile attack on Kyiv overnight, firing more than 20 missiles that ignited fires across multiple districts including fuel storage in Obolonsky district, while simultaneously striking Odessa's logistics center and a commercial hypermarket. Ukrainian forces launched Operation 'Vivaldi,' with the Third Army Corps deploying Griffins and NRK kamikaze drones 10 kilometers into Russian rear areas near Fedorivka. Russian ground offensives continued with advances up to 500 meters in the Velikoburluk sector and ongoing gains west of Zorevka, Zarnitsa, and Chervona Krynytsia in the Zaporizhzhia direction.

points: Ukrainian Third Army Corps conducted Operation "Vivaldi," employing Griffins and NRK kamikaze drones to strike Russian positions 10 km deep into enemy rear near Fedorivka, marking the first operational use of these systems by the corps. (Source: @UkraineNow/84287)

Ukrainian drone forces launched 35 drones overnight targeting Russian regions including Belgorod, Bryansk, Kursk, Oryol, Krasnodar, Bashkortostan, Crimea, and the Black Sea, all reportedly destroyed by Russian air defenses according to the Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
A Ukrainian drone attack on the private sector in Kursk city injured a 50-year-old man, damaging a house, garage, car, and store, and causing a fire. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
Ukrainian forces deployed a Hornet drone with a fragmentation warhead over Yasinovataya in the DPR, which was shot down by Russian mobile fire groups. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Ukrainian strikes on Belgorod region over 24 hours totaled 150 attacks across 13 municipalities, including 14 artillery, aviation, and missile strikes, six drone-dropped explosives, and 145 drones destroyed or suppressed, resulting in eight civilian injuries with two in serious condition. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Ukrainian drone attacks in the LPR injured four civilians across 15 municipalities, hitting a house of culture in Rubizhne, a car in Novopskovsky district, and a kindergarten in Troitsk district where a security guard was wounded. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Ukraine's metallurgical sector produced zero steel in September for the first time in a century; all plants destroyed by shelling, with Metinvest losing five furnaces ($500M each) and ArcelorMittal losing two, while state aid offered only 2–5 million hryvnias per furnace. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33494)

Russian forces launched over 20 ballistic missiles at Kyiv overnight, causing fires in multiple districts including fuel tanks in the Obolonsky district, with the mayor reporting a large fire at fuel storage facilities. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Russian Ministry of Defense confirmed strikes on Ukrainian logistics and storage terminals used for military supply, specifically hitting a logistics center in Odessa storing military cargo. (Source: @tass_agency/397184)

In the Sumy direction, Russian assault groups advanced near Khoteni, Kiyanitsa, and Maryino in Sumy district, with infantry fighting near Malaya Rybitsa; Russian aviation, artillery, and drones struck Sumy, Glukhov, Dorozhovka, Grunivka, Tolstodubovo, Fotovizha, and Stepka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Kharkiv direction, Russian aviation and drones struck Veliky Burluk, Svetlichny, Pitomnik, Izbitsky, Revolyutsionny, Berezhnoy, Prikolotny, Reznikov, Serdobino, Kirillovka, Gnilitsa Perovaya, Podsredny, Mikhailovka, Olkhovtka, and Varvarovka; assault groups advanced deeper near Petropavlovka and Rublenoye in Volchansk sector. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Zaporizhzhia direction, Russian units from the Far East advanced west of Zorevka; assault groups occupied enemy strongholds northwest of Zarnitsa, west of Lesnoye, Rovnoye, Kopany, Chervona Krynytsia, and Novoselovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Kherson direction, Russian forces detected a camouflaged Ukrainian strike drone command post on the Dnieper's right bank, transmitted coordinates, and destroyed it with aviation; mutual artillery and drone strikes continued across the river. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
Russian air defenses destroyed 145 Ukrainian drones over Belgorod region in 24 hours, while 150 Ukrainian attacks injured eight civilians across 13 municipalities. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the DPR, Russian strikes hit Shakhtarsk, Novy Svet in Starobeshevsky district, and Gorlovka; in Kalininsky district of Gorlovka a civilian was injured and residential buildings damaged; energy infrastructure damage left over 185,000 subscribers in Donetsk without electricity, with outages in Makiivka, Yasinovataya, and Gorlovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the LPR, four civilians were injured by Ukrainian drone attacks across 15 municipalities, including an elderly woman near a house of culture in Rubizhne, a man and woman in a car in Novopskovsky district, and a security guard at a kindergarten in Troitsk district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Krasnolimansky direction, Russian units conducted 13 attacks near Novoselovka, Drobysevo, Liman, Maslyakovka, and Dibrova; in the adjacent Slavyansk sector, five attacks were reported near Yampol, Starodubovka, and Nikolaevka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
The Kupyansk direction saw no significant changes according to the Two Majors summary. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
Russian forces shot down a Ukrainian Hornet drone with a fragmentation warhead over Yasinovataya using mobile fire groups. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Sumy direction, heavy positional battles continue with Russian assault groups advancing in several areas; Russian forces have transferred refurbished armored vehicles to the Sumy region and are striking with aviation, artillery, and drones across Sumy, Glukhov, Dorozhovka, Grunivka, Tolstodubovo, Fotovizha, and Stepka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Russian advances reported near Khoteni, Kiyanitsa, and Maryino in Sumy district, with infantry fighting near Malaya Rybitsa; in Shostkinsky district, Russian units advanced near Ulanovo and Tolstodubovo; heavy fighting continues near Stepka in Krasnopolsky district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Kursk region, a Ukrainian drone attacked the private sector in Kursk city, injuring a 50-year-old man and damaging a house, garage, car, and store, causing a fire. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Belgorod region endured 150 Ukrainian attacks in 24 hours across 13 municipalities, including 14 artillery, aviation, and missile strikes, six drone-dropped explosives, and 145 drones destroyed; eight civilians injured, two seriously. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Kharkiv direction, Russian aviation and drones struck numerous settlements including Veliky Burluk, Svetlichny, Pitomnik, Izbitsky, Revolyutsionny, Berezhnoy, Prikolotny, Reznikov, Serdobino, Kirillovka, Gnilitsa Perovaya, Podsredny, Mikhailovka, Olkhovtka, and Varvarovka; advances in forest belts south of Goptovka in Liptsivsk direction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
Russian assault groups advanced up to 500 meters on four sectors in the Velikoburluk direction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
A Shahed drone launched from Belarus targeted Zhytomyr region's Korosten district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75685)

Russian forces struck a logistics center in Odessa used for military cargo storage, and a construction hypermarket "New Line" was hit during the night. (Source: @tass_agency/397184, @ukr_leaks_eng/33477)

In the Zaporizhzhia direction, Russian units from the Far East advanced west of Zorevka; assault groups seized strongholds northwest of Zarnitsa, west of Lesnoye, Rovnoye, Kopany, Chervona Krynytsia, and Novoselovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

In the Kherson direction, mutual strikes across the Dnieper continued with active drone activity; Russian aviation destroyed a camouflaged Ukrainian strike drone command post on the right bank after coordinate transmission; left bank settlements Velikaya Lepetikha, Hornostayovka, Zavodovka, Kairy, Novaya Kakhovka, Dnepryany, Kakhovka, and Proletarka came under artillery fire. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)

Multiple reactive Shahed drones launched from Black Sea waters targeted Odesa, Chornomorsk, and Zatoka; additional Shaheds from Chernihiv region targeted Kyiv region's Vyshhorod district; one Shahed from Zaporizhzhia targeted Kherson region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75690)
Reactive UAVs detected near Kaniv reservoir heading westward, over Odessa city heading northwest, and from Black Sea toward Zatoka/Serhiivka. (Source: @kpszsu/80024, @kpszsu/80025, @kpszsu/80007)
Groups of strike UAVs operating east of Budzhak settlement in Odesa region on course toward Artsyz/Sarata. (Source: @kpszsu/80017)
During the attack on Ukraine, four drones were recorded in Moldovan airspace, prompting Poland to scramble aviation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84275)

Overnight Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv involved more than 20 missiles, causing fires in multiple districts including fuel tanks in Obolonsky district; air raid alerts active in Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, Zhytomyr, Poltava, Kharkiv, Cherkasy, and Chernihiv regions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
Large fire reported in Dnipropetrovsk after series of explosions; fires also recorded in Vinnytsia region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
Russian guided aerial bombs launched by tactical aviation on Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @kpszsu/79989)

Multiple reactive Shahed drones launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region's Vyshhorod district (three drones), and one reactive Shahed toward Vasylkiv in Kyiv region; one Shahed from Belarus toward Zhytomyr region's Korosten district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75685)
Reactive Shahed drones from Black Sea waters targeted Odesa, Chornomorsk, Zatoka; one reactive Shahed from Zaporizhzhia toward Kherson region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75690)

Reactive UAV detected near Kaniv reservoir heading west; reactive UAV over Odessa city heading northwest; reactive UAV from Black Sea toward Zatoka/Serhiivka. (Source: @kpszsu/80024, @kpszsu/80025, @kpszsu/80007)
Ukrainian drone Hornet with fragmentation warhead shot down over Yasinovataya by Russian mobile fire groups. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33476)
